description: This file defines an interface for a dictionary component within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It includes nested interfaces for notifications and iteration over dictionary entries, and provides methods for registering observers, getting and setting key-value pairs, and obtaining iterators.

classes.name: IDictionary
classes.description: An interface for dictionary operations, allowing access to key-value pairs within different namespaces, and enabling observers to be registered for change notifications.

classes.name: IDictionary::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications when a value in the dictionary changes.

classes.name: IDictionary::IIterator
classes.description: Interface providing iteration over dictionary entries within a namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification sink to observe changes within a specific namespace.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a notification sink from a specific namespace.

methods.name: Get (const string&, const string&, string&)
methods.description: Retrieve the value associated with a given key in a namespace.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Set the value for a specific key within a namespace.

methods.name: Get (const string&)
methods.description: Obtain an iterator for all entries in a namespace.
